messages:
Alec M.: Heads-up: Sev2 from AcmeCorp. New hires aren't getting created in our backend after SSO. SCIM logs show repeated 5xx when writing to KMS-wrapped service account keys.
Priya S.: thanks — can you paste the exact error from the SCIM job logs?
Alec M.: log snippet: ```2026-06-02T14:02:11Z ERROR scim.sync: failed to upsert user john.doe@acme.com -> kms.Decrypt: rpc error: code = Internal desc = HSM timeout```
Jorge R.: HSM timeout during decrypt usually points to KMS cluster reaching concurrency limits. Did they recently onboard a bunch of users?
Alec M.: They did a bulk invite ~10k yesterday. SupportBot: Alert created: #INC-2026-234 - high-volume provisioning error reported.
Nina L.: quick repro: trigger SCIM sync for one user via platform API: `POST /internal/scim/sync?tenant=acme` then watch `scim-provisioner` logs. I saw the same HSM timeout locally after 300 concurrent requests.
Priya S.: workarounds? Can we fallback to ephemeral keys or queue retries instead of failing the whole upsert?
Ezra K.: short-term: throttle SCIM concurrency (reduce workers to 8) and enable exponential backoff on KMS decrypt. I've pushed a canary config to staging: `SCIM_WORKERS=8 KMS_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=500,1000,2000`.
Jorge R.: Also check RBAC on the service account used for SCIM: if permissions are least-privilege, maybe our new key rotation policy prevented re-use and triggered extra KMS calls.
Alec M.: I validated policy — service account still has decrypt on kms-key-acme-1. Rotation happened but IAM bindings were updated. Strange part: audit logs show `decrypt` calls succeeding but SCIM still raising HSM timeouts.
Nina L.: timeline looks like: 13:58 bulk invites -> 14:00 high concurrency -> 14:02 first HSM timeout errors -> 14:12 SCIM retries exhausted -> user not created.
Priya S.: action items: 1) throttle SCIM workers on prod tenant acme (Ezra), 2) enable KMS backoff + retries (Ezra), 3) export and attach audit log slice for 13:55-14:20 (Alec), 4) contact infra on HSM cluster saturation (Jorge). I'll own customer comms.
Ezra K.: on it — will push rollout to the acme tenant config in the next 10m and monitor.
SupportBot: Deployment started for config acme@prod by Ezra K.
Alec M.: also note customer asked about data retention/audit: they want evidence that failed provision attempts don't expose PII and that keys weren't used to decrypt content beyond user metadata. Include that in the audit slice.
Jorge R.: when collecting audit logs, include `kms.decrypt` entries and correlate request IDs with scim-provisioner request_id. I can run a quick grep and produce a CSV.
Nina L.: temp mitigation verified on staging — reduced worker count eliminated HSM timeouts for same bulk job.
Priya S.: thanks team. I'll update ticket INC-2026-234 with repro steps and mitigation. Postmortem: we need a least-privilege review for SCIM service accounts + a gating mechanism for high-volume onboards that auto-switches to queued mode.
Alec M.: adding: consider adding a synthetic alert when KMS latency crosses 200ms sustained for >=30s so SRE can autoscale HSM cluster or flip to queued mode. :thumbsup:
